references.text: Previous instruction on making the two silver trumpets that the priests were to use
The priests blew the trumpets during the war against the Midianites, in accordance with the eternal statute
The priests carried seven horns before the ark of the covenant at Jericho, a continuation of the priests' role with wind instruments
The priests blew trumpets before God's ark of the covenant when it was brought to Jerusalem
The Levitical priests with trumpets at the dedication of Solomon's temple
The priests blew trumpets before battle, in line with the eternal statute given to Aaron's sons
The priests blew trumpets during Hezekiah's temple cleansing and worship service
The priests with trumpets at the founding of the second temple, in accordance with David's regulations
Aaron's sons were appointed as priests, the basis for their role as trumpet players
The expression 'an eternal statute for all generations' is also used here regarding the Lord's ordinances
